verses.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.pt: Prosseguiu Eliú ainda, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Elihu also continued, and said,
verses.en_bbe: And Elihu went on to say,

verses.en: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
verses.pt: Espera-me um pouco, e eu te mostrarei que ainda há palavras a favor de Deus.
verses.en_web: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
verses.en_bbe: Give me a little more time, and I will make it clear to you; for I have still something to say for God.

verses.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.pt: Desde longe trarei meu conhecimento, e a meu Criador atribuirei a justiça.
verses.en_web: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.en_bbe: I will get my knowledge from far, and I will give righteousness to my Maker.

verses.en: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.pt: Porque verdadeiramente minhas palavras não serão falsas; contigo está um que tem completo conhecimento.
verses.en_web: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.en_bbe: For truly my words are not false; one who has all knowledge is talking with you.

verses.en: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
verses.pt: Eis que Deus é grande, porém despreza ninguém; grande ele é em poder de entendimento.
verses.en_web: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, God gives up the hard-hearted, and will not give life to the sinner.

verses.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.pt: Ele não permite o perverso viver, e faz justiça aos aflitos.
verses.en_web: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives to the afflicted their right.
verses.en_bbe: His eyes are ever on the upright, and he gives to the crushed their right;

verses.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.pt: Ele não tira seus olhos do justo; ao contrário, ele os faz sentar com os reis no trono, e assim são exaltados.
verses.en_web: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
verses.en_bbe: Lifting them up to the seat of kings, and making them safe for ever.

verses.en: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.pt: E se estiverem presos em grilhões, e detidos com cordas de aflição,
verses.en_web: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
verses.en_bbe: And if they have been prisoned in chains, and taken in cords of trouble,

verses.en: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.pt: Então ele lhes faz saber as obras que fizeram, e suas transgressões, das quais se orgulharam.
verses.en_web: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
verses.en_bbe: Then he makes clear to them what they have done, even their evil works in which they have taken pride.

verses.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.pt: E revela a seus ouvidos, para que sejam disciplinados; e lhes diz, para que se convertam da maldade.
verses.en_web: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: Their ear is open to his teaching, and he gives them orders so that their hearts may be turned from evil.

verses.en: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.pt: Se ouvirem, e o servirem, acabarão seus dias em prosperidade, e seus anos em prazeres.
verses.en_web: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.en_bbe: If they give ear to his voice, and do his word, then he gives them long life, and years full of pleasure.

verses.en: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.pt: Porém se não ouvirem, perecerão pela espada, e morrerão sem conhecimento.
verses.en_web: But if they don’t listen, they shall perish by the sword; they shall die without knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: But if not, they come to their end, and give up their breath without knowledge.

verses.en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.pt: E os hipócritas de coração acumulam a ira divina; e quando ele os amarrar, mesmo assim não clamam.
verses.en_web: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have no fear of God keep wrath stored up in their hearts; they give no cry for help when they are made prisoners.

verses.en: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
verses.pt: A alma deles morrerá em sua juventude, e sua vida entre os pervertidos.
verses.en_web: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
verses.en_bbe: They come to their end while they are still young, their life is short like that of those who are used for sex purposes in the worship of their gods.

verses.en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.pt: Ele livra o aflito de sua aflição, e na opressão ele revela a seus ouvidos.
verses.en_web: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
verses.en_bbe: He makes the wrong done to the poor the way of their salvation, opening their ears by their trouble.

verses.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
verses.pt: Assim também ele pode te desviar da boca da angústia para um lugar amplo, onde não haveria aperto; para o conforto de tua mesa, cheia dos melhores alimentos.
verses.en_web: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

verses.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
verses.pt: Mas tu estás cheio do julgamento do perverso; o julgamento e a justiça te tomam.
verses.en_web: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

verses.en: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.pt: Por causa da furor, guarda-te para que não sejas seduzido pela riqueza, nem que um grande suborno te faça desviar.
verses.en_web: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

verses.en: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.pt: Pode, por acaso, a tua riqueza te sustentar para que não tenhas aflição, mesmo com todos os esforços de teu poder?
verses.en_web: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

verses.en: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.pt: Não anseies pela noite, em que os povos são tomados de seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

verses.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.pt: Guarda-te, e não te voltes para a maldade; pois por isto que tens sido testado com miséria.
verses.en_web: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
verses.en_bbe: Take care not to be turned to sin, for you have taken evil for your part in place of sorrow.

verses.en: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.pt: Eis que Deus é exaltado em seu poder; que instrutor há como ele?
verses.en_web: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
verses.en_bbe: Truly God is lifted up in strength; who is a ruler like him?

verses.en: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.pt: Quem lhe indica o seu caminho? Quem poderá lhe dizer: Cometeste maldade?
verses.en_web: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
verses.en_bbe: Who ever gave orders to him, or said to him, You have done wrong?

verses.en: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.pt: Lembra-te de engrandeceres sua obra, a qual os seres humanos contemplam.
verses.en_web: “Remember that you magnify his work, whereof men have sung.
verses.en_bbe: See that you give praise to his work, about which men make songs.

verses.en: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.pt: Todas as pessoas a veem; o ser humano a enxerga de longe.
verses.en_web: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
verses.en_bbe: All people are looking on it; man sees it from far.

verses.en: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.pt: Eis que Deus é grande, e nós não o compreendemos; não se pode descobrir o número de seus anos.
verses.en_web: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, God is great, greater than all our knowledge; the number of his years may not be searched out.

verses.en: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.pt: Ele traz para cima as gotas das águas, que derramam a chuva de seu vapor;
verses.en_web: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
verses.en_bbe: For he takes up the drops from the sea; he sends them through his mist as rain,

verses.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
verses.pt: A qual as nuvens destilam, gotejando abundantemente sobre o ser humano.
verses.en_web: Which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
verses.en_bbe: Flowing down from the sky, and dropping on the peoples.

verses.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.pt: Poderá alguém entender a extensão das nuvens, e os estrondos de seu pavilhão?
verses.en_web: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
verses.en_bbe: And who has knowledge of how the clouds are stretched out, or of the thunders of his tent?

verses.en: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.pt: Eis que estende sobre ele sua luz, e cobre as profundezas do mar.
verses.en_web: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
verses.en_bbe: See, he is stretching out his mist, covering the tops of the mountains with it.

verses.en: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.pt: Pois por estas coisas ele julga aos povos, e dá alimento em abundância.
verses.en_web: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
verses.en_bbe: For by these he gives food to the peoples, and bread in full measure.

verses.en: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
verses.pt: Ele cobre as mãos com o relâmpago, e dá ordens para que atinja o alvo.
verses.en_web: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
verses.en_bbe: He takes the light in his hands, sending it against the mark.

verses.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.pt: O trovão anuncia sua presença; o gado também prenuncia a tempestade que se aproxima.
verses.en_web: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
verses.en_bbe: The thunder makes clear his passion, and the storm gives news of his wrath.
